FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Larry Stutts
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/03/2026
Senate Bill 81 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Insurance by an undetermined amount to hire additional personnel to administer the provisions
of this bill regarding the regulation of dental insurance.
